svg.text: Expo / React Native — customers; staff: support requests, schedule impact
React 19 + Vite + Ant Design — staff workspace and customer portal (/customer)
Minimal-API endpoints · Hub · Hosted workers · Middleware (auth, permissions)
Contracts · DTOs · Permission grants · System messages
Services · EF Core persistence · Background workers · External adapters
Entities · Status constants · Business rules (no dependencies)
Dependency rule: Api → Application → Infrastructure → Domain. Finance has no Application package: payments are ledger rows (AUDIT_LOG) handled in Api and Infrastructure.Treatment.
